translations.text: Simeon Peter, servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those to whom an honor equal to yours has been allotted: faith, through the righteousness of God and of the Savior Jesus Christ.
Grace be with you, and may peace be multiplied through the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
He has granted us all the power of his own divinity for life and for the service of God, through the knowledge of him who called us to his own glory and virtue.
Through these he has granted us very great and precious promises, so that through them you may become sharers in the divine nature, escaping the corruption of the lust of this world.
And you too, in the same way, apply all diligence and add virtue to your faith, and knowledge to virtue,
fasting to knowledge, patience to fasting, godliness to patience,
brotherly love to godliness, and love to brotherly love.
When these are among you and abound, you will be found neither idle nor fruitless in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
The person who lacks these is blind. He sees an insect [?] as a shadow, for he has forgotten that he was cleansed of his former sins.
Therefore, brothers, be all the more eager to make your calling and your election firm through good works. If you do this, you will never go astray.
Instead, in this way you will be richly granted entry into the eternal kingdom of our God and Savior Jesus Christ.
For this reason we will take care to remind you always, even though you know these things and stand firm in the truth that has come to you.
I have thought it right, as long as I am in this world, to stir you up by reminding you.
I know that I must soon leave this dwelling of mine, as our Lord Jesus Christ made known to me.
And I will make every effort so that after my departure each of you may be able to remember these things.
For we did not follow fables of [human] knowledge when I made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. Instead, we ourselves saw his richness.
For he received honor and glory from God the Father, when a voice came to him from such great and exceedingly beautiful glory: "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."
And we heard this voice come from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
And we have the prophetic word, which is more certain. You will do well to pay attention to it as to a lamp lit in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star shines forth in your hearts.
Know this first of all: no prophecy of scripture is a matter of one's own interpretation.
For prophecy never came by human will. Rather, the holy men of God spoke as they were moved by the Holy Spirit.

There were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will bring in destructive heresies and deny the Lord who set them free, and they will bring swift destruction on themselves.
And many will follow their impurity, and because of them the way of truth will be blasphemed.
And out of greed, with lying words, they will exploit you. Their judgment has long been at work and does not rest, and their destruction does not sleep.
For God did not spare the angels who sinned, but bound them with chains of darkness and handed them over to torment, to be kept under punishment.
Nor did he spare the ancient world, but kept Noah safe, the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, and brought the flood of water on the world of the ungodly.
And he burned the cities of the Sodomites and the Gomorrahites, overthrew them and condemned them, and made them an example for those who would later be ungodly.
And he rescued righteous Lot, who was oppressed among those lawless people who lived in filthiness.
For while that righteous man lived among them, he saw and heard their lawless deeds, and his righteous soul was tormented by them day after day.
The Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trial, but he keeps the false under punishment for the day of judgment.
Above all, the bold and self-willed do not tremble before the glorious ones, but slander them.
Yet angels, who are mighty in power and greater than they are, do not bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
But these people are like irrational beasts, born by nature to be caught and destroyed. They slander what they do not understand, and they will be destroyed in their own corruption.
And they will receive the wages of their falsehood. They count lust as pleasure, like a day of luxury. Stained and blemished, they revel in their love-feasts and [?] with you.
Their eyes are full of adultery and never cease from sin. They lure unstable souls. Their hearts are trained in greed. They are children of a curse.
They have left the straight way and gone astray, and they follow the way of Balaam son of Bosor, who loved the wages of falsehood.
But he was rebuked for his own lawlessness by a mute beast of burden, which spoke with a human voice and restrained the prophet's madness.
These people are waterless springs and mists driven about by the wind, and the gloom of darkness is reserved for them.
For they speak arrogant, empty words, and with the lusts and filthiness of the flesh they lure those who have only just escaped from a life of error.
They promise them freedom, yet they themselves are slaves of corruption. For people are slaves to whatever has overcome them.

For if people escaped the defilement of this world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, but are again entangled in it and overcome, their last state has become worse than their first.
It would have been better for them never to have known the way of truth than to know it and then turn back from the holy commandment that was given to them.
What has happened to them fits the true proverb: "A dog returns to its own vomit," and "A sow that has been washed goes back to wallowing in the mud."
Beloved, this is now the second letter I am writing to you. In it I am stirring up your sincere minds by way of reminder,
so that you may remember the words spoken in the past by the holy prophets, and the commandment of the Lord and Savior given through your apostles.
First of all, you must understand this: in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own desires,
And they will say, “Where is the promise of his coming? For since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they have from the beginning of creation.”
For they deliberately forget that the heavens existed then, and that the earth was formed out of water and through water by the word of God.
Through which the world of that time was destroyed when it was overwhelmed by water.
But now the heavens and the earth are stored up by that same word, and kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly people.
Do not let this one thing escape your memory, beloved: with the Lord one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.
The Lord will not delay his promise, but he is patient with you. He does not want anyone to perish, but wants all to come to repentance.
But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. On that day the heavens will pass away with violence, the elements will burn and melt, and the earth and the works in it will be burned up.
Since all these things are to be dissolved in this way, how fitting it is for you to live in holy conduct and good service.
Let us wait for and hasten the coming of the day of God, on which the burning heavens will be dissolved, and the elements will burn and melt.
According to his promise we wait for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
Therefore, beloved, as you wait for this, hasten to him undefiled and blameless, so that you may be found in peace.
And regard the Lord's patience as salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you, according to the wisdom given to him.
He speaks about this in all his letters. There are some things in them that are hard to understand, which the unlearned and unstable twist, as they do the other scriptures, to their own destruction.
But you, brothers, since you know this beforehand, be on your guard, so that you are not led away by that lawless error and fall from your own steadfastness.
Grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory now and forever, and to the days of eternity. Amen.
